basics.title: Senior Android Developer
basics.summary: Senior Android Developer with 13+ years of experience building secure, scalable, and high-performance Android applications for enterprise and consumer products. Expert in Kotlin, Android SDK, MVVM/Clean Architecture, Coroutines, Flow, Compose and modern Jetpack components. Proven track record of leading features end-to-end, improving code quality, and collaborating across cross-functional teams.

highlights: Designed, implemented and delivered tokenization feature for small business banking app (1M+ active users), strengthening protection of sensitive customer data using Kotlin and modern Android architecture.
Built lock/unlock plugin using a modern Android stack (Coroutines, Flow, Compose) with comprehensive unit and UI tests, ensuring a maintainable and testable design.
Leveraged Kotlin for end-to-end Android development, utilizing features like null-safety, extension functions, higher-order functions, and coroutines to write concise, safe, and maintainable code.
Led Gravity design system migration for 15+ screens, collaborating with design and product teams to ensure accessibility compliance and modernize the UI.
Increased unit test coverage to over 90%, significantly reducing regression issues across all Kotlin modules.
Actively participated in PR reviews, release regression testing, and Agile ceremonies.
Worked on the Comcast Business Android app (100k+ downloads); improved app performance and optimized app startup time by 40%, improving Play Store rating from 2 to 4.2.

Designed reusable Android components and internal libraries while modularizing the codebase into feature and core modules, improving cross-app scalability, feature delivery speed, and build reliability.
Delivered multiple customer-facing features in a large legacy Java codebase while refactoring key components and migrating them to Kotlin to improve maintainability and performance.
Implemented offline support using Room, push notifications, and VOIP calling.
Integrated Google Maps, demo mode, flexible in-app updates, and enhanced app security by implementing encrypted SharedPreferences and biometric authentication.
Led offshore-onshore coordination, conducted code reviews, and supported production releases.
Developed Android apps for planning and budget management with charts and analytics.
Integrated in-app purchases, Firebase, REST APIs, reminders, and notifications.
Improved app stability by preventing crashes and memory leaks; applied ProGuard obfuscation.
Led a small Android team and managed Git repositories.
Gained hands-on experience with iOS development using Swift.
Implemented localization and new features for J&J Care4Today healthcare app.
Developed several News Android applications with charts, live feed, and complex UI.
Participated in architecture design and module planning.
Explored hybrid mobile POCs using Ionic and NativeScript.
Integrated social APIs, implemented core app functionality, and built reusable libraries.
Created POCs using Google Maps SDK and navigation features.
